page.layout: One column of Gothic text in red-ruled staff lines with square musical notation, cut off at the right edge of the leaf. A large decorated red and blue initial stands at the left. No margin notes or running head.
page.notes: This is a manuscript leaf, not a printed page. It comes from a liturgical chant book (antiphoner or gradual): the red staff lines and square notes are musical notation, which I have not transcribed. Only the Gothic text lines are given. The text is cut off at the right edge, so the line ends are missing. The first line may begin with an abbreviation mark. The second line appears to be Song of Songs 4:11 ("favus distillans"), but I have copied only the letters I can see. The lower lines are very faint and largely unreadable. The left margin shows faint marks, probably show-through or wear, and I have not transcribed them.
